rules.title: Soulless Writing
rules.problem: Writing that is technically clean but lacks personality, opinions, rhythm, or human voice.

rules.title: Undue Emphasis on Significance, Legacy, and Broader Trends
rules.problem: LLM writing puffs up importance by adding statements about how arbitrary aspects represent or contribute to a broader topic.

rules.title: Undue Emphasis on Notability and Media Coverage
rules.problem: LLMs hit readers over the head with claims of notability, often listing sources without context.

rules.title: Superficial Analyses with -ing Endings
rules.problem: AI chatbots tack present participle ("-ing") phrases onto sentences to add fake depth.

rules.title: Promotional and Advertisement-like Language
rules.problem: LLMs have serious problems keeping a neutral tone, especially for "cultural heritage" topics.

rules.title: Vague Attributions and Weasel Words
rules.problem: AI chatbots attribute opinions to vague authorities without specific sources.

rules.title: Outline-like "Challenges and Future Prospects" Sections
rules.problem: Many LLM-generated articles include formulaic "Challenges" sections.

rules.title: Overused "AI Vocabulary" Words
rules.problem: These words appear far more frequently in post-2023 text. They often co-occur.

rules.title: Avoidance of "is"/"are" (Copula Avoidance)
rules.problem: LLMs substitute elaborate constructions for simple copulas.

rules.title: Negative Parallelisms
rules.problem: Constructions like "Not only...but..." or "It's not just about..., it's..." are overused.

rules.title: Rule of Three Overuse
rules.problem: LLMs force ideas into groups of three to appear comprehensive.

rules.title: Elegant Variation (Synonym Cycling)
rules.problem: AI has repetition-penalty code causing excessive synonym substitution.

rules.title: False Ranges
rules.problem: LLMs use "from X to Y" constructions where X and Y aren't on a meaningful scale.

rules.title: Em Dash Overuse
rules.problem: LLMs use em dashes (—) more than humans, mimicking "punchy" sales writing.

rules.title: Overuse of Boldface
rules.problem: AI chatbots emphasize phrases in boldface mechanically.

rules.title: Inline-Header Vertical Lists
rules.problem: AI outputs lists where items start with bolded headers followed by colons.

rules.title: Title Case in Headings
rules.problem: AI chatbots capitalize all main words in headings.

rules.title: Emojis
rules.problem: AI chatbots often decorate headings or bullet points with emojis.

rules.title: Curly Quotation Marks
rules.problem: ChatGPT uses curly quotes (“...”) instead of straight quotes ("...").

rules.title: Collaborative Communication Artifacts
rules.problem: Text meant as chatbot correspondence gets pasted as content.

rules.title: Knowledge-Cutoff Disclaimers
rules.problem: AI disclaimers about incomplete information get left in text.
words_to_watch: Up to my last training update

rules.title: Sycophantic/Servile Tone
rules.problem: Overly positive, people-pleasing language.

rules.title: Filler Phrases
words_to_watch: In order to achieve this goal
Due to the fact that it was raining
In the event that you need help
The system has the ability to process
It is important to note that the data shows

rules.title: Excessive Hedging
rules.problem: Over-qualifying statements.

rules.title: Generic Positive Conclusions
rules.problem: Vague upbeat endings.
